newsitem.title: USA: LXR Biotechnology names president, COO.
newsitem.headline: LXR Biotechnology names president, COO.

text.p: LXR Biotechnology Inc said Tuesday it has named Donald Picker as president and chief operating officer.

Picker takes over the president's role from David Tomei, a co-founder, who will remain chief executive officer. He assumes the chief operating officer title from Mark Tomei, who keeps his position as chief financial officer.
Picker was formerly Chief Operating Officer at Corvas International, and the senior vice president for research and development at Genta Inc
Picker also has been named to LXR's board of directors.
